notes: Dawson County (State Auditor), cash basis, FY ended June 30, 2024. Statement p4 Total Governmental Funds column; beginning/ending are cash basis fund balances. ending_investments 2,083,854 (p3) is informational and already inside ending cash. Statement Miscellaneous 1,915,390 split using the Statement of Activities general receipts (p2): Insurance Reimbursements 513,606 + Road Project Cost Reimbursements 986,308 + Miscellaneous 415,476. Balance sheet: Statement of Cash Basis Assets and Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (p3) Total column; totals equal the p1 Statement of Net Position. Detail: General Fund budget schedule (p5-6), Taxes 12,847,313 split using the p4 General Fund column (budget 12,845,862 for the whole line, so budget_final null on the pieces); major funds Road, Inheritance, Insurance (p7-8); Sinking Fund had no actual receipts, disbursements or transfers (budget disbursements 3,800,000 only), so no lines; nonmajor funds via Total Nonmajor Funds column of the combining statement (p14-18) since there are 29 funds; per-fund nonmajor budget schedules (p9-13) not recorded to avoid double counting.
